reviews.text: One happy 🐕 …

Great experience with an online purchase (Betterbone in large size, hard density and most importantly - BEEF flavour) that I struggled to find this specific item in stock in the UK anywhere else. For a small independent business, the item was shipped super quickly, well packaged and loved the hand written note, such an unnecessary but so appreciated, personal touch. Given the amount of orders they must get, that personal connection of a hand written thank you card is what independent business is about rather than larger, online giants. Sadly, I’m not local but if I was I’m sure we’d be a frequent customer. Either way, I’m sure we’ll be back m, even if only virtually.
Great dog shop! Lovely owner and a great selection of snacks! Would recommend it.
Best shop for doggies :)) great choice and lovely people

Update have just left the shop where understandably the lady was not at all happy and refunded me on the spot. I did not want to upset the lady and I wanted to support her shop, not minding the slightly higher prices which are to be expected. I’m neurodivergent so I tell the truth without prejudice nor with a bad mind so when I saw that a sticker had been stuck over the original one I saw I was shocked. I think it would have been better if there had been a discussion about the d price not being correct instead of sticking the higher price on top which is what happened.
I feel shamed for asking about discounts, I have little money and that’s not to be ashamed of, yet I feel embarrassed by that comment. Yes my little lad does have a sensitive tummy however the lady is going to send the sticks back to the manufacturer to be tested which is very responsible.
I have no malice and my communication is bad yet I’ve come away with an odd feeling which I can’t explain.
Perhaps I’m not the target customer. I wish the lady every success and am sad that I don’t feel I’d be welcomed back.
I bought a dog lead for £13.99 when I got home I noticed a sticker for £18.99 had been stuck over the sticker I’d seen. I’m going back today to find out if this was accidental. I also bought fish stick treats which made my dog violently sick. I’m hoping the sticker was a mistake and can be rectified. If not I will have no option but to contact Which to check my statuary rights. I’m very disappointed as all I wanted to do was support a local shop. When I got home the £18.99 sticker was stuck over the original price I sav£13.99 and another had appeared. None of this was discussed with me.

Thank you!!

Really good independent local shop, with a great selection of dog treats for the space, from training treats through to natural dog chews (and dog food). They also stock lots of toys and dog accessories (leads, harnesses, coats etc.). The staff and owners are friendly and knowledgeable, and good sources of advice.

The shop is dog friendly, and they're super welcoming of the local canine population (maybe too much...I now get dragged down the street towards them by my dog at every opportunity!)

It’s a shame that this shop sells out of date products, holding no accountability when bringing this up to their attention stating that they are best before dates so as long as they don’t smell they are fine to eat Im talking months out of date. The product was purchased in February and the best before was October. My puppy got diarrhoea for days after eating some of the treats. It’s a local shop that I would’ve loved to support but I’ll take my money somewhere else.
